title: Add request logging to the API

tasks.objective: Add a structured request logger module with a unit test.
tasks.acceptance: Every request logs method, path, status and duration as one JSON line.
tasks.verification: npm test passes, including the new logger test.

tasks.objective: Add a LOG_LEVEL setting read from the environment, defaulting to info.
tasks.acceptance: LOG_LEVEL accepts debug, info, warn and error and refuses anything else.
tasks.verification: npm test passes, including a test for the refused value.

tasks.objective: Register the request logger as middleware, honoring LOG_LEVEL.
tasks.acceptance: Requests to every route are logged at the configured level.
tasks.verification: npm test passes, including an integration test for one route.
